about: Every Library collection as a pack of texts that a download can leave out (tools/make_release.py --without=slug,slug) or add later (the optional ones have a zip of their own). Slugs are short names for the collections in src/js/6g-library.js; tests/packs.test.js checks that every collection is listed here exactly once.
